correctness.rationale: Independent recomputation confirms the exact core. Q=a^2+a'+1 with a=2x+1/(2x)+1/x^2 equals 4x^2+5+4/x-1/(4x^2)-1/x^3+1/x^4; s=16x^6+20x^4+16x^3-x^2-4x+4, t=4x^4, so the only finite pole is x=0 of order 4 and o(inf)=-2. Gauge check (P=[[1,0],[a,1]], W=PY) gives exactly the companion [[0,1],[Q,0]], so system reducibility is equivalent to a rational Riccati solution. Case 1: from R=w'+w^2-Q with w=l/x^2+m/x+q0+px, coefficients give l^2-1=0, 2lm-2l+1=0, p^2-4=0, 2pq0=0 and t1=(5-p)/(2p); all four combos give d=t1-m in {1/4,-9/4,-3/4,-13/4}, none a nonnegative integer, so no invariant line. E-sets E_0={4}, E_inf={-2} give Case-2 d=-3 and Case-3 d=-2,-3,-6 for n=4,6,12, all inadmissible; necessary-condition gates already exclude Cases 2 and 3. Permissive Case-2 pair (2,2),d=0 fails step 3 since S(1/x)=-32x-20/x-8/x^2-2/x^4+4/x^5 != 0 (recomputed exactly). Hence Kovacic Case 4 holds and G^0=SL(2,C), so G=SL(2,C). The Stokes trace relation tr(M_0)=-(2+s1*s2) is correct for formal monodromy -I, and the numerics are kept only as corroboration. The DRAFT's correction that there are no formal logarithms (central -I resonance) is accurate and does not disturb the density argument.
